disclaimers.illustrative_data: All vehicle specifications, pricing, mileage/range, and maintenance figures are sample illustrative estimates for Indian two-wheelers and not verified live manufacturer data.
disclaimers.pricing_notice: Fuel rates (₹102/L) and residential power tariffs (₹8/kWh) are illustrative benchmarks and vary across Indian states and discoms.
disclaimers.cost_exclusions: Calculations include estimated purchase price, fuel/energy expenses, and standard periodic service maintenance. Calculations exclude insurance premiums, vehicle financing/interest (EMI), regional RTO road taxes, battery degradation replacement, tyre replacements, and resale value.
disclaimers.neutrality_pledge: SahiDrive does not automatically promote EVs or ICE vehicles. Recommendations are calculated objectively based on your budget, travel pattern, and charging realities.
